name: Elasticsearch
problems: license changed from permissive Apache 2.0 (through 7.10) to source-available SSPL/Elastic License 2.0 (2021), prompting an AWS-led fork (OpenSearch); AGPLv3 was added as a third, OSI-approved option in September 2024
source_notes: Distributed search and analytics engine built on Apache Lucene, maintained by Elastic. Since 2024 dual/tri-licensed under SSPL 1.0, Elastic License 2.0, and AGPLv3 (client libraries remain Apache 2.0).
